answer: Cross-epoch continuity rule: each agent identity must present signed receipts from prior epochs showing the same task role and counterparty set. A relic from epoch t is accepted only if it matches epoch t−1 activity and is non-transferable. A lotus-service receipt cannot be copied to another identity because signer, role, and counterparty are bound. Likewise, orchard-maintenance receipts must be unique per identity. Attackers pay N epochs of real task work, separate storage, and distinct counterparties per sybil; shared history fails verification.
